name: next-lite
description: Suggests up to three next prompts above the input from a small digest of the turn on a cheap model, instead of forking the whole session.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto suggests after each qualifying turn; manual only when you run /next.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: row shows the suggestions side by side; column stacks them one under another.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model alias or id that writes the suggestions.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: In auto mode, skip turns whose answer is shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Send the names (not descriptions) of this session's skills and commands, so a suggestion can be one of them.
